title: North Korea launches ballistic missile that falls outside Japan's exclusive economic zone
summary: Tokyo condemned the launch into the Sea of Japan; the projectile reportedly traveled about 690 kilometers.

title: Japan pays tribute to victims of Japan Airlines Flight 123 on 41st anniversary
summary: Family members and relatives made offerings and held a lantern festival on Mount Osutaka, also remembering the deceased executives.

title: Typhoon 15 crosses Honshu, leaving heavy rain and damage in Japan
summary: The storm, downgraded to a tropical depression, triggered flood alerts, road and railway closures, and some minor injuries.

title: Fourth Koshien game postponed due to typhoon
summary: The match between Tokai Daikofu and Kenko Takasaki was rescheduled for August 13 due to bad weather.

title: Okuda Shoichiro, former president of Toyota and Keidanren, dies at 93
summary: The business leader drove Toyota's global expansion and the modernization of Japan's main business lobby.

title: Kumamoto earthquake leaves death toll of 392 and pending reconstruction challenges
summary: Authorities updated the casualty figure and are reviewing the municipal response, electrical self-sufficiency, and food security in affected areas.

title: Oil rises and Wall Street falls over uncertainty about Iran and the Middle East
summary: New York crude closed above $83 and the Dow Jones lost 184 points amid skepticism about negotiations between the United States and Iran.

title: Sony and TSMC to build joint image sensor plant in Kumamoto
summary: The companies plan to begin mass production of next-generation sensors in 2029 with a major investment.

title: Tokyo Metro resumes Hanzomon Line after removing asbestos-containing material
summary: The discovery of asbestos at Hanzomon Station forced the suspension of service for about 14 hours.

title: Earthquake in western Colombia leaves more than 200 dead
summary: Authorities report 224 deaths and collapsed buildings in several cities, in an earthquake considered the deadliest in the last ten years.

title: Syrian court sentences former President Bashar al-Assad to death
summary: The sentence, handed down in absentia while Assad lives in exile in Russia, can hardly be carried out.

title: Hungary elects former Supreme Court chief Baka as president
summary: The new head of state, 73, takes office amid a reorganization of power by Orbán's party.

title: Ukraine denounces North Korean reinforcement to Russia and a North Korean missile kills seven people
summary: Zelensky warned of the dispatch of more North Korean troops, while a Pyongyang missile caused casualties at a Ukrainian steel plant.

title: Yen holds around 159 per dollar amid caution over US inflation
summary: Markets await consumer price data and assess the possibility of a rate hike this year.

title: Iran appoints new military and security chiefs amid tensions with United States
summary: The Iranian regime is strengthening its defense leadership in the face of the possibility of a prolonged conflict with Washington.

title: Japan debates reform of imperial law to preserve male succession
summary: Analysts and politicians are examining the possibility of allowing men from collateral branches of the throne to be adopted as heirs.

title: Mie defeats Matsusho Gakuen and advances at Koshien for first time in five years
summary: Mie scored steadily and resisted Matsusho's late comeback attempt to win their first game of the tournament.

title: Riseisha comes from behind against Kyoei and wins its first game at Koshien
summary: The Osaka team prevailed thanks to timely hitting and the effort of starter Kimura, who threw 167 pitches.

title: Takudai Koryo returns to Koshien after 24 years and advances to third round
summary: The Chiba team defeated Saga Shogyo and celebrated its return with fan stories and a two-generation family storyline.
